% guestpass — printable pass cards.
%
% Generated by:  guestpass tex --config guestpass.yaml > pass.tex
% Compiled by:   pdflatex pass.tex
%
% Requires only the `qrcode` package (LPPL 1.3, CTAN), which draws QR codes with
% the TeX \rule primitive. No shell-escape, no external program, no graphics
% package. Compiles unchanged with pdflatex, xelatex, lualatex, and on Overleaf.
%
% Everything below the CARDS marker is what `guestpass tex` regenerates.

\documentclass[a4paper,11pt]{article}

\usepackage[margin=15mm]{geometry}
\usepackage[nolinks]{qrcode}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage{helvet}
\renewcommand{\familydefault}{\sfdefault}
\pagestyle{empty}

% level=H tolerates a scuffed or partly obscured card.
% padding adds the 4-module quiet zone the QR specification requires; the
% package omits it by default, and a card trimmed flush to the code will not
% scan reliably without it.
\qrset{level=H,padding}

% \passcard{label}{hint}{url}
\newcommand{\passcard}[3]{%
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    \node[draw,rounded corners=2mm,line width=0.3pt,
          inner sep=4mm,minimum width=62mm,minimum height=78mm] (c) {%
      \begin{minipage}{54mm}
        \centering
        \qrcode[height=34mm]{#3}\\[4mm]
        {\large\bfseries #1}\\[1.5mm]
        {\footnotesize #2}
      \end{minipage}};
  \end{tikzpicture}%
}

\begin{document}
\noindent
% --- CARDS ---
\passcard{Living room lamp}{Scan to switch on}%
  {HTTPS://GP.EXAMPLE.COM/T/K7QF3M2X9WPLNA4RTVBC6DHJ8Z/LAMP/ON}%
\hfill
\passcard{Living room lamp}{Scan to switch off}%
  {HTTPS://GP.EXAMPLE.COM/T/K7QF3M2X9WPLNA4RTVBC6DHJ8Z/LAMP/OFF}
% --- END CARDS ---
\end{document}
